overall_summary: Analysis of 47 deduplicated Shorts shows extreme cosmic survival and high-stakes 'What If' scenarios dominate channel performance. Videos leveraging the first-person immersion framework ('What If You Fell Into...') and exotic extreme planetary conditions regularly cross 800–1,000+ views with high engagement (likes/comments), whereas generic psychology facts ('Your Brain Can Create Fake Memories' <20 views) and recycled biology trivia ('Octopuses Have THREE Hearts') consistently fail to gain traction. The 19–21 second runtime window correlates with significantly higher algorithmic reach and viewer retention.

winning_patterns.pattern: First-Person Extreme Hazard Simulation ('What If You Fell Into...')
winning_patterns.evidence: 'What If You Fell Into a Liquid Diamond Planet?' (1,029 views, 38 likes) and 'What If You Fell Into the Planet of Burning Ice?' (972 views, 18 likes) achieved the highest engagement and views on the channel.
winning_patterns.action: Use visceral second-person sensory immersion ('You step out onto...', 'Your suit melts in 0.2 seconds...') to trigger immediate stake-driven retention.

winning_patterns.pattern: Extreme Physical Paradoxes in Space (19-21s format)
winning_patterns.evidence: 'The Planet Darker Than Coal: TrES-2b' (1,030 views, 36 likes) and 'Venus Has a Day Longer Than Its Year' (981 views, 21 likes) outperformed sub-16s clips by 5x-10x.
winning_patterns.action: Target cosmic phenomena featuring intense sensory contradictions (e.g., metals boiling in frozen vacuums, crushing gravity, magnetic distortion) within a 19–21 second pacing structure.

weak_patterns.evidence: 'Your Brain Can Create Fake Memories' achieved between 5 and 53 views across multiple uploads, and 'Your Brain Is Hiding This From You' reached only 38 views.
weak_patterns.action: Retire passive abstract cognitive trivia unless framed through high-stakes psychological survival or micro-horror storytelling.

weak_patterns.pattern: Repetitive Static Re-uploads with Identical Titles
weak_patterns.evidence: Duplicate concepts like 'Why Space Is Completely Silent' and 'Octopuses Have THREE Hearts' yielded diminishing engagement floor values (<35 views) when repeated without narrative evolution.
weak_patterns.action: Enforce strict uniqueness rules; explore novel entities rather than recycling covered celestial bodies or well-known biology facts.
